Acceptance: standalone installer; signed automatic and explicit updates; configurable agent/model/permission/tmux defaults; offline updater, installer, CLI and real tmux validation; protected iad-ci Transit release workflow deployed through declarative-config; signed first release published and mirrored; bootstrap transition prepared/published without capturing concurrent checkout edits; installed launcher verified. One owning bead covers application source, bootstrap adoption and GitOps release manifests. No speculative child work.

Canonical repository /home/coding/harnessctl, origin https://git.ardenone.com/jedarden/harnessctl.git; public GitHub server-side mirror confirmed. Installed command remains start. Implemented signed automatic and explicit start update, generated authenticated installer, atomic replacement, downgrade/tracked-source/unrelated-command protection, separate agent-update control, configurable models/permissions/tmux/workdir, pinned public trust key, immutable archives, release.py, offline fixtures and real tmux checks. Private release key remains non-exportable in OpenBao Transit.
Production release v1.4.0: f87ab1bf25a64a48320b288111c2b1e823580164; annotated tag v1.4.0 mirrored to GitHub and points to that release. Protected workflow harnessctl-release-sign-manual-hp9xx Succeeded, all clone/prepare/sign/verify/main containers Succeeded. Production python3 scripts/release.py check passed. Both main and releases/v1.4.0 raw GitHub artifact sets match exact authenticated local bytes. Signed installer downloaded from the pinned archive installed successfully into a scratch path containing spaces; --version and update both returned v1.4.0. Installed actual /home/coding/start.sh through the same authenticated installer; start --version and start update succeed and installed bytes match archived v1.4.0. Existing PATH symlink retained.
Bootstrap transition v1.3.3: f7ab4fc50955ae613e9c8d50ecf57dc348c576c0; workflow harnessctl-bootstrap-adopt-manual-vc7vm Succeeded with signed harness commit fenced as input and previous bootstrap main 32993be fenced. Clean scratch checkout scripts/start-sh-release.sh --check passed syntax, embedded/archive equality, signed artifact hashes and host completeness; distribution-check passed Forgejo/GitHub commit and all raw artifact convergence. Deployed signed bridge in scratch and ran update: authenticated 1.3.3 -> 1.4.0, original update arguments re-executed, final bytes equal signed standalone archive. Both standalone bridge and bootstrap retain old bootstrap REPO_URL; only launcher UPDATE_REPO_URL points to harnessctl. Shared dirty bootstrap checkout and unrelated declarative-config edits preserved.
Verification: BOOTSTRAP_SOURCE=<clean bootstrap clone> scripts/check.sh passed complete locally on renamed source including signing/installer/updater/interface/configuration/release/bootstrap-adoption fixtures and real private-server tmux uid1000. Complete gate also passed as root through runuser/nobody uid65534, and in exact pinned Python CI image with read-only source and 768Mi/1CPU limits. Bootstrap adoption fixture passed separately in that exact image after exposing shared-object clone alternates. Production CI complete gate passed as nobody. gitleaks dir . --redact --no-banner passed on released repository, no leaks. All GitOps commits passed installed pre-commit secret/DNS guards. YAML, embedded shell syntax, signer-only projected token isolation and actual pinned OpenBao UID100 read/write permissions verified. Resource gate latest: 531 files,274 existing findings,0 critical. Read-only proxy capacity check:7 nodes,30.50 CPU/83.82Gi allocatable,19.55 CPU/38.14Gi committed; requests fit available capacity and a node.
GitOps delivery: declarative-config/k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/harnessctl-release-sign-workflowtemplate.yml and harnessctl-bootstrap-adopt-workflowtemplate.yml, target iad-ci / ArgoCD argo-workflows-ns-iad-ci. Initial templates d2944c9, removed excluded one-shot Workflow request 16527227, restored required non-root signer token/manifest/output-directory permissions 94fc24bf, concurrent template rename 0723a139. Live harnessctl templates both Synced. ArgoCD excludes one-shot Workflows, so releases were submitted by approved template references using refreshed kubeconfig, the documented exception in global CLAUDE.md. Earlier runs failed before publication at CI root/nologin fixture guards, non-root signer permissions, or stale clone URL during rename; each resolved and final protected runs Succeeded.
All requested functional deliverables and verification are complete. Remaining required deployment acceptance: shared parent ArgoCD Application is still OutOfSync/Degraded with its transition at 2026-10-03T06:46:50Z predating these changes, unrelated exporter/pdftract WorkflowTemplates OutOfSync, no conditions on our delivery, and both harnessctl resources Synced. declarative-config AGENTS requires the parent Application Synced and Healthy before bead closure; leave this bead in_progress until that pre-existing shared application condition clears. No unrelated infrastructure changes or speculative beads created.
Final fleet acceptance: codinghome and lab both report start v1.4.0, resolve ~/.local/bin/start to ~/start.sh, use https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jedarden/harnessctl/main, and have exact launcher SHA-256 d3cc12b4eb5ff8678551041d771690e2ee80500dbd28b3dda76620fa802e39ae. Lab first refused the signed bridge because a stale ~/.local/bin/openssl required absent libssl.so.1.1/libcrypto.so.1.1; no launcher bytes changed.
